name: comp-221
title: Inline Prefix Select
description: A select where the trigger wraps static text (e.g., 'Language: ') followed by SelectValue, appearing inline within the field.
use_when: A contextual prefix clarifies what value is being selected inline.
avoid_when: When a separate label above the field is clearer or space is constrained.
a11y: Prefix text is inline; semantic meaning depends on context.
